# 📦 lumen

**Title:** Statistical Tests, Confidence Intervals, and Distributions  
**License:** GPL (≥ 2)

## 🧩 Overview

`lumen` is the inferential layer of the **DescToolsX ecosystem**. It
provides classical, robust, nonparametric and specialised hypothesis
tests, confidence intervals for the common estimands, and a set of
probability distributions that base R does not carry.

Tests return ordinary `"htest"` objects and intervals follow one
argument convention throughout, so procedures from very different
literatures can be combined without translating between interfaces.

The package is self-contained and does not require the higher-level
packages of the suite.

📖 **Documentation:** <https://andrisignorell.github.io/lumen/>

## ⚙️ Installation

``` r

install.packages("lumen")
```

Or the development version from GitHub:

``` r

remotes::install_github("AndriSignorell/lumen")
```

### 🔹 Confidence Intervals

- Proportions: [`binomCI()`](reference/binomCI.md),
  [`binomDiffCI()`](reference/binomDiffCI.md),
  [`binomRatioCI()`](reference/binomRatioCI.md),
  [`multinomCI()`](reference/multinomCI.md)
- Counts and rates: [`poissonCI()`](reference/poissonCI.md),
  [`poissonDiffCI()`](reference/poissonDiffCI.md),
  [`poissonRatioCI()`](reference/poissonRatioCI.md)
- Location and scale: [`meanCI()`](reference/meanCI.md),
  [`meanDiffCI()`](reference/meanDiffCI.md),
  [`medianCI()`](reference/medianCI.md),
  [`quantileCI()`](reference/quantileCI.md),
  [`varCI()`](reference/varCI.md), [`sumCI()`](reference/sumCI.md)
- Correlation: [`corCI()`](reference/corCI.md),
  [`fisherZ()`](reference/fisherZ.md)
- General: [`bootCI()`](reference/bootCI.md) for arbitrary statistics

### 🔹 Distributions

`dpqr` families for the Benford, Dirichlet, extreme value, Fréchet, GEV,
GPD, Gompertz, Gumbel, reversed Gumbel, order-statistic, reverse Weibull
and triangular distributions, plus
[`cont.moments()`](reference/cont.moments.md),
[`disc.moments()`](reference/disc.moments.md) and
`extreme-value-moments()`.

### 🔹 Power and Sample Size

- [`meanCIn()`](reference/meanCIn.md),
  [`powerChisqTest()`](reference/powerChisqTest.md),
  [`sphericityEps()`](reference/sphericityEps.md),
  [`scores()`](reference/scores.md)

## 🚀 Design Principles

- **Consistent** — lowerCamelCase API, uniform argument names and
  ordering across the whole DescToolsX suite
- **Standard output** — tests return `"htest"` objects and print like
  the ones in base R
- **Fast** — bootstrap and permutation routines implemented in C++ via
  Rcpp, RcppArmadillo and RcppParallel
- **Documented** — references to the original literature on every
  procedure

## 🧪 Example

``` r

library(lumen)

# a confidence interval for a proportion, several methods
binomCI(37, 100, method = "wilson")

# nonparametric alternative to the t test
brunnerMunzelTest(extra ~ group, data = sleep)

# post-hoc comparisons after an ANOVA
fit <- aov(breaks ~ tension, data = warpbreaks)
postHoc(fit, method = "hsd")

# goodness of fit
andersonDarlingTest(rnorm(100), null = "pnorm")
```

## 🧱 The Suite

`lumen` builds on `bedrock` (base utilities) and `pharos` (graphics).
`DescToolsX` (descriptive statistics), `alloy` (modelling), `pons`
(MS-Office) and `swissValet` (RStudio addins) complete the family.

## 🙏 Acknowledgements

Parts of the code and documentation were reviewed with the help of large
language models (OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude). Every suggestion was
assessed, edited and verified by the maintainer, who remains solely
responsible for the content of this package.

and quantiles.

  Confidence Interval for a Mean
- [`meanDiffCI()`](meanDiffCI.md) : Confidence Interval For Difference
  of Means

- [`quantileCI()`](quantileCI.md) : Confidence Interval for Any Quantile
- [`sumCI()`](sumCI.md) : Add Up Partial Confidence Intervals to a Total
  CI

## Confidence Intervals for Proportions, Rates & Dispersion

- [`poissonCI()`](poissonCI.md) : Confidence Interval for a Poisson Rate

  Ratio of Two Poisson Rates

- [`madCI()`](mad-confints.md) [`madDiffCI()`](mad-confints.md)
  [`madRatioCI()`](mad-confints.md) : Confidence Intervals for Median
  Absolute Deviations
- [`varCI()`](varCI.md) : Confidence Interval for a Variance

## Location & Correlation Tests

Parametric, nonparametric, robust, multivariate, and correlation tests.

- [`brunnerMunzelTest()`](brunnerMunzelTest.md) : Brunner-Munzel Test
  for Comparing Stochastic Dominance Between Two Independent Samples
- [`hotellingsT2Test()`](hotellingsT2Test.md) : Hotelling's T2 Test for
  Comparing Multivariate Mean Vectors
- [`moodMedianTest()`](moodMedianTest.md) : Mood's Median Test for
  Comparing Medians Across Independent Groups
- [`signTest()`](signTest.md) : Sign Test for Testing a Median or Paired
  Median Difference
- [`tTestA()`](tTestA.md) : Student's T-Test Based on Sample Statistics
  for Performing T-Tests From Summary Statistics
- [`vanWaerdenTest()`](vanWaerdenTest.md) : Van Der Waerden Test for
  Comparing Group Locations Using Normal Scores
- [`yuenTTest()`](yuenTTest.md) : Yuen T-Test for Robust Comparison of
  Trimmed Means
- [`zTest()`](zTest.md) : Z-Test for Testing Means With Known Population
  Standard Deviations
- [`corTest()`](corTest.md) : Fast Correlation Test for Testing Pairwise
  Correlations in a Matrix

## Categorical Data Tests

Tests for proportions, contingency tables, marginal homogeneity, and
ordinal trends.

- [`barnardTest()`](barnardTest.md) : Barnard's Unconditional Test for
  Comparing Two Independent Proportions in a 2×2 Table
- [`bhapkarTest()`](bhapkarTest.md) : Bhapkar Marginal Homogeneity Test
  for Comparing Paired Marginal Distributions Across Multiple Categories
- [`breslowDayTest()`](breslowDayTest.md) : Breslow-Day Test for
  Comparing Odds Ratios Across Strata
- [`cochranArmitageTest()`](cochranArmitageTest.md) : Cochran-Armitage
  Test for Detecting Trends in Proportions Across Ordered Groups
- [`cochranQTest()`](cochranQTest.md) : Cochran's Q Test for Comparing
  Matched Binary Responses Across Multiple Conditions
- [`gTest()`](gTest.md) : G-Test for Likelihood-Ratio Testing of Count
  Data
- [`lehmacherTest()`](lehmacherTest.md)
  [`print(`*`<MHTest>`*`)`](lehmacherTest.md) : Lehmacher's Test for
  Locating Asymmetry in Paired Multicategory Data
- [`mantelTrendTest()`](mantelTrendTest.md) : Mantel Linear-by-Linear
  Association Test for Detecting Linear Association Between Ordinal
  Variables
- [`stuartMaxwellTest()`](stuartMaxwellTest.md) : Stuart-Maxwell Test
  for Testing Marginal Homogeneity in Paired Multicategory Data
- [`woolfTest()`](woolfTest.md) : Woolf Test for Comparing Odds Ratios
  Across Stratified 2×2 Tables

## Variance & Dispersion Tests

Parametric, robust, and rank-based comparisons of variability.

- [`leveneTest()`](leveneTest.md) : Levene's Test for Comparing
  Variances Across Groups
- [`mosesTest()`](mosesTest.md)
  [`print(`*`<mosesTestResult>`*`)`](mosesTest.md) : Moses Test of
  Extreme Reactions for Comparing Extreme-Value Behaviour Between Two
  Groups
- [`siegelTukeyTest()`](siegelTukeyTest.md) : Siegel-Tukey Test for
  Comparing Dispersion Between Two Independent Groups
- [`varTest()`](varTest.md) : Variance Test for Testing One Variance or
  Comparing Two Variances

## Normality & Goodness-of-Fit Tests

Tests for normality and distributional goodness of fit.

- [`andersonDarlingTest()`](andersonDarlingTest.md) : Anderson-Darling
  Test for Assessing Distributional Fit, Especially in the Tails
- [`cramerVonMisesTest()`](cramerVonMisesTest.md) : Cramer-Von Mises
  Test for Assessing Deviations From Normality
- [`jarqueBeraTest()`](jarqueBeraTest.md) : (Robust) Jarque-Bera Test
  for Assessing Normality From Skewness and Kurtosis
- [`lillieTest()`](lillieTest.md) : Lilliefors (Kolmogorov-Smirnov) Test
  for Assessing Normality With Estimated Parameters
- [`pearsonTest()`](pearsonTest.md) : Pearson Chi-Square Test for
  Assessing Normality From Grouped Frequencies
- [`shapiroFranciaTest()`](shapiroFranciaTest.md) : Shapiro-Francia Test
  for Assessing Normality From Normal Scores

## Trend, Randomness & Time Series Tests

Tests for stationarity, trends, serial dependence, and randomness.

- [`adfTest()`](adfTest.md) : Augmented Dickey-Fuller Unit Root Test for
  Detecting Unit Roots in Time Series
- [`bartelsRankTest()`](BartelsRankTest.md) : Bartels Rank Test of
  Randomness for Detecting Non-Random Order in Continuous Sequences
- [`kpssTest()`](kpssTest.md) : Kwiatkowski-Phillips-Schmidt-Shin Test
  for Assessing Level or Trend Stationarity
- [`runsTest()`](runsTest.md) : Runs Test for Detecting Non-Random Order
  in Sequences
- [`vonNeumannTest()`](vonNeumannTest.md) : Von Neumann's Successive
  Difference Test for Detecting Serial Dependence in Continuous
  Sequences
- [`coxStuartTest()`](coxStuartTest.md) : Cox-Stuart Trend Test for
  Detecting Monotonic Trends in Ordered Data
- [`jonckheereTerpstraTest()`](jonckheereTerpstraTest.md) :
  Jonckheere-Terpstra Test for Detecting Ordered Differences Across
  Independent Groups
- [`pageTest()`](pageTest.md) : (Exact) Page Test for Detecting Ordered
  Treatment Effects in Blocked Designs

## Regression Diagnostics

Tests for heteroscedasticity, autocorrelation, calibration, and model
fit.

- [`bpTest()`](bpTest.md) : Breusch-Pagan Test for Detecting
  Heteroscedasticity in Regression Models
- [`breuschGodfreyTest()`](breuschGodfreyTest.md) : Breusch-Godfrey Test
  for Detecting Higher-Order Serial Correlation in Regression Residuals
- [`durbinWatsonTest()`](durbinWatsonTest.md) : Durbin-Watson Test for
  Detecting First-Order Autocorrelation in Regression Residuals
- [`hosmerLemeshowTest()`](hosmerLemeshowTest.md)
  [`print(`*`<HosmerLemeshowTest>`*`)`](hosmerLemeshowTest.md) :
  Hosmer-Lemeshow Goodness of Fit Test for Assessing Logistic Regression
  Calibration
- [`leCessieTest()`](leCessieTest.md)
  [`print(`*`<LeCessieTest>`*`)`](leCessieTest.md) : Le Cessie-Van
  Houwelingen-Copas-Hosmer Global Goodness of Fit Test for Assessing
  Global Logistic Regression Fit

## Multiple Comparisons & Post-Hoc Tests

Parametric and nonparametric multiple-comparison procedures and result
helpers.

- [`conoverTest()`](conoverTest.md) : Conover's Test for Pairwise Rank
  Comparisons After a Kruskal–Wallis Test
- [`dscfTest()`](dscfTest.md) : Dwass-Steel-Critchlow-Fligner Test for
  Nonparametric All-Pairs Group Comparisons
- [`dunnettTest()`](dunnettTest.md) : Dunnett's Test for Comparing
  Several Treatments With a Common Control
- [`dunnTest()`](dunnTest.md) : Dunn's Test for Pairwise Rank
  Comparisons After a Kruskal–Wallis Test
- [`gamesHowellTest()`](gamesHowellTest.md) : Games-Howell Post-Hoc Test
  for Pairwise Mean Comparisons Under Unequal Variances
- [`nemenyiTest()`](nemenyiTest.md) : Nemenyi Test for Nonparametric
  All-Pairs Rank Comparisons
- [`postHocTest()`](postHoc.md)
  [`print(`*`<PostHocTest>`*`)`](postHoc.md) : Post Hoc Tests for
  Multiple Comparisons Following Anova
- [`scheffeTest()`](scheffeTest.md) : Scheffé Test for Testing Arbitrary
  Contrasts Following Anova
- [`steelTest()`](steelTest.md) : Steel Test for Nonparametric
  Comparisons With a Common Control
- [`plot(`*`<PostHocTest>`*`)`](plot.PostHocTest.md) : Plot Routine for
  Posthoc Tests Results
- [`print(`*`<rankTest>`*`)`](print.rankTest.md) : Print Method for
  rankTest Objects
- [`signifDiff()`](signifDiff.md)
  [`print(`*`<signifDiff>`*`)`](signifDiff.md) : Significantly Different
  Levels per Group

## Statistical Utilities & Power

Transformations, scoring, repeated-measures corrections, and power
calculations.

- [`fisherZ()`](fisherZ.md) [`fisherZInv()`](fisherZ.md) : Fisher's
  z-Transformation
- [`scores()`](scores.md) : Compute Scores for Ordinal Contingency
  Tables
- [`powerChisqTest()`](powerChisqTest.md) : Power Calculations for Power
  and Sample-Size Calculations for Chi-Square Tests
- [`sphericityEps()`](sphericityEps.md) : Greenhouse-Geisser And
  Huynh-Feldt Epsilons
